name: Los Angeles
dek: Los Angeles International Airport, WMO 72295, by the coast.
paragraphs: The station is Los Angeles International Airport, WMO 72295, height 30 m, position 33°56′17″N, 118°23′20″W. It sits near the ocean, so inland valleys run hotter in summer. No tipping or tap-water source was opened for US sheets on this pass.

The highest average high in the table is 24.8 °C, in August. The lowest average low is 9.5 °C, in December. The wettest month by the precipitation column is February, at 76.0 mm, and the driest is August, at 0.1 mm.

climate.caption: Station: Los Angeles International Airport, WMO 72295. Not downtown.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3.
climate.sourceTitle: WMO climate normals 1991-2020, Los Angeles International Airport (72295)

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type A and B, 120 V, 60 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows United States at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Section 21650 of the California Vehicle Code, on the Legislature's site, says that on all highways a vehicle shall be driven on the right half of the roadway, with exceptions such as overtaking, left turns, closures, and one-way roads.
driving.sourceTitle: California Vehicle Code 21650, California Legislative Information

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the US Dollar, code USD, for the United States of America. It also lists US Dollar (Next day), code USN, a funds code, which is not printed as the currency.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab gives the United States 29 rows. America/Los_Angeles is commented Pacific. The other US rows are not collapsed into it.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.note: CBP's page for international visitors. It applies to travelers arriving from outside the United States. We do not restate a visa rule.
